SELECT w.id, w.code, w.source, w.status, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, u.name AS unitName, w.planned_qty AS plannedQty FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = w.product_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id = m.unit_id
(w.code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR m.code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR m.name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
AND w.status != #{cancelledStatus} AND w.status = #{status}
ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId, SUM(c.effective_qty) AS quantity, COUNT(c.id) AS factCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.execution_id) AS executionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.effective_qty IS NULL OR c.effective_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidCount, MAX(c.recorded_at) AS lastCompletedAt FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_execution_completion c ON c.execution_id = e.id WHERE e.workorder_id IN #{id} GROUP BY e.workorder_id
